mismatches.reading: By the comparator's own stated threshold, p = 0.0795 for MACE is below 0.10, yet it concludes that no asymmetry was revealed. The conflict is recorded as it stands: this page does not repeat the reassuring wording, and it does not claim small-study bias either (an Egger test over 7 trials, one of which carries 97.44% of the inverse-variance weight, has very little power in either direction).
